title: Carb entry in AAPS that I cannot find the source
symptom: User found a carb entry of 25g at 11:45 PM in AAPS and Nightscout, but they were asleep and did not enter it. Carb sync from Nightscout is turned off, and no reference to 25g carbs appears in AAPS logs.
